title: Capability Snapshot v1
description: Frozen execution contract (SW-1510-CONTRACT). Time-bounded, collector-measured capability record for a route or harness. A snapshot is valid only within [measured_at, expires_at]; an expired or absent snapshot means unknown capacity, which is never treated as unlimited. Readiness and limits come from the measuring service.

expires_at.description: After this instant the snapshot is stale and must be re-measured.

capabilities.description: Measured capabilities. Unknown is not the same as supported.

evidence_level.description: How the snapshot was established; a bare installation is not a capability measurement.

limits.description: Limits observed by the measuring service; unknown limits are recorded as unknown, not unlimited.

issuer.description: Authenticated measuring service; not a model-authored claim.
